verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea can bring in repositories from elsewhere. The docs mention migrating from Gogs, one user migrated the TiDB repo onto the 'Try Gitea' service, and another relies on the mirror feature. Another user found migrating existing repos 'surprisingly difficult', and nothing shows issues, pull requests, reviews or comments coming across. missing for 10: documented import of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments; supported source-platform list; first-party migration docs; hands-on corroboration of a smooth migration that includes metadata.
